messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: increased paging + model warmup failures in us-west-2. Symptoms: P95 token latency spike, 5xx surge, node flaps. Error summary: CUDA driver lost, model load OOM, deserialize checksum errors, compile timeout. Auto-escalating to on-call.

sasha: seeing same. Warmup logs show repeated: "deserializing shard 3 failed: checksum mismatch" then OOM in loader. A few nodes hit GPU reset.

maya: stacktrace snippet from one worker: `fatal: driver lost connection during cuMemAlloc, pid=4121` then `compile timeout: kernel build exceeded 120s` — looks like driver resets during JIT/compile under memory pressure.

eng-oncall: initial mitigation plan: 1) pause new warmups (route new model loads to fallback), 2) scale up driver nodes + increase swap limit on warmup pods, 3) enable aggressive eviction of large inactive KV caches. Can someone run route fallback?

sasha: doing route shift now. Running: `redwoodctl route set --model redwood-llama-7b@v3 -> redwood-llama-3b@v2 --reason "warmup OOM mitigation"`

incident-bot: Action logged: route change applied by sasha at 4444441258. Fallback routing in effect.

ops-brenda: I started a temporary node pool scale: +4 gpu-nodes (p4d), cloud autoscaler bumped. Also drained 2 nodes showing repeated GPU resets. `kubectl drain gpu-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

sean-sre: to reduce compile pressure, disable precompile for quantized kernels on the warmup path: set ENV VAR `REDWOOD_PRECOMPILE=0` for warmup pods. Pushing a short patch to the warmup deployment now.

maya: note — we have ~2.1% 5xx rate in production over the last 6m, primarily model-init timeouts. Affected customers: subset of realtime endpoints (prod) and some Dedicated customers in us-west-2. Customer-impact page: brief outage risk; no data exfil reported.

eng-oncall: good. Also flipping on fallback model will reduce footprint but raise latencies for some calls. Notify product for customer comms?

sasha: pinging @product for a short banner. Also logging which requests were rerouted: `traces.filter(route="fallback")` shows traffic started moving at 4444441259.

raj: taking over on-call in 20m. Can someone paste checklist for handoff? I can stay longer if needed.

sean-sre: handoff checklist: 1) verify fallback routing persists, 2) confirm new nodes stabilized and drained nodes reprovisioned, 3) monitor GPU driver resets (metric: node.gpu.driver_resets), 4) watch compile timeout count (metric: model.compile.timeout.count), 5) keep model cache eviction policy aggressive until warmup queue drops <5/min.

ops-brenda: added temporary SLO relax for warmup to avoid cascading failures. Also disabled automatic prefetch for big models for 30m.

maya: root cause hypothesis: combined spike in concurrent warmups + a quantized precompile JIT that temporarily consumes >GPU-mem during kernel builds, triggering driver resets and OOMs. Evidence: compile timeouts + driver lost logs + deserialize attempts right before OOM.

eng-oncall: agreed. Next steps: 1) backfill a fix to precompile to use smaller workspace or stream compile onto CPU, 2) add a hard cap on concurrent warmups per node, 3) add checksum validation fallback to avoid endless deserial retries.

incident-bot: Severity downgraded to SEV-2 at 4444441330 (mitigations applied, 5xx rate falling).

raj: acknowledged handoff. I will monitor for the next 2 hours and coordinate with research to push a safe precompile rollback by EOD if needed. Please add all relevant traces + sample logs to the incident doc.

sean-sre: copying important logs to incident doc: `s3://redwood-incident-logs/4444441234/warmup/*.log` and added a short repro note.

ops-brenda: customer impact summary for oncall: ~15 customers saw increased latency, 3 large customers had transient 5xx spikes for ~4 minutes. No sustained data loss. Reqs affected mostly during model init window.

maya: preparing postmortem draft now, will include timeline, mitigations applied, and rollout for a precompile config change.

eng-oncall: leaving a note: if driver_resets > 3/min again, escalate to infra-eng and consider node image rollback.

raj: thanks — taking over. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Handoff recorded: previous on-call eng-oncall -> raj at 4444441380.

sasha: closing loop for now, leaving watch on traces and warmup queue. Update here with any new anomalies. :white_check_mark:
